title: COVseq is a cost-effective workflow for mass-scale SARS-CoV-2 genomic surveillance
protocol: Mix RNA, 50 μM random hexamers, 10 mM dNTPs, and Nuclease-Free Water as specified.
Incubate the mixture for 5 min at 65 °C.
Place the tube immediately on ice for 5 min.
Add 5x SSIV buffer, 0.1 M DTT, RNaseOUT, and SSIV Reverse Transcriptase enzyme to the mixture.
Perform PCR thermocycler steps as follows: 23 °C for 10 min, then 50 °C for 10 min, followed by 85 °C for 10 min, with a hold at 4 °C after completion.
Add RNase H to the tube and incubate for 20 min at 37 °C.
Note: RNase H is an optional step.
Mix NEBNext Q5 Hot Start HiFi PCR Master Mix, Nuclease-Free Water, Primer pool (10 μM), and 4x SYBR Green as specified.
Add 3 μL of cDNA to each tube/well.
Perform the following steps in PCR thermocycler with the lid set to 105 °C.
Incubate at 98 °C for 30 seconds.
Incubate at 98 °C for 15 seconds.
Incubate at 65 °C for 5 minutes.
GOTO step 2, repeat 40 times.
Hold at 4 °C.
Pool 20 μL from each of the six amplicon pools into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube or 96 well plate.
Add 1 volume of AMPure XP beads pre-warmed at room temperature.
Mix thoroughly and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand.
Incubate until clear, at least 5 minutes.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol.
Air-dry the beads at room temperature for 5–8 minutes to avoid low DNA yield.
Resuspend the beads in 80 μL of Nuclease-Free Water.
Incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place the sample back on the magnetic stand.
Incubate until clear, at least 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 μL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Check the library concentration using Qubit dsDNA BR kit.
Pool 20 μl from each of the two amplicon pools into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube or 96 well plate.
Add 0.8 vol/vol ratio of AMPure XP beads pre-warmed at room temperature to the pooled sample.
Mix thoroughly and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for at least 5 min until the liquid appears clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol.
Air-dry the beads at room temperature for 5–8 minutes.
Remove the sample from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend the beads in 40 μL of Nuclease-Free Water.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Place the sample back on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for at least 5 min until the liquid appears clear.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Check the library concentration using Qubit dsDNA BR kit.
Store samples at –20 °C if needed.
Dispense 10 nL to 50 nL of purified PCR amplicons.
Dispense Nuclease-Free Water to a total volume of 350 nL.
Mix the following components:
Pipette NlaIII enzyme 50 nL.
Pipette MseI enzyme 50 nL.
Pipette 10x CutSmart Buffer 50 nL.
Dispense 150 nL per well.
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 h.
Incubate at 65 °C for 20 min.
Hold at 4 °C.
Dispense 150 nL of 33 nM COVseq adaptor of NlaIII per well.
Dispense 150 nL of 33 nM COVseq adaptor of MseI per well.
Mix the following components for ligation:
Pipette Nuclease-free water 250 nL (standard ligase) or 50 nL (rapid ligase).
Pipette 5x T4 ligase buffer 150 nL (standard ligase) or 300 nL (rapid ligase).
Pipette ATP 10 mM 120 nL.
Pipette BSA 50 mg/ml 30 nL.
Pipette T4 standard ligase 150 nL (standard ligase) or T4 rapid ligase 200 nL (rapid ligase).
Dispense the mixture to a total volume of 700 nL per well.
Incubate at 22°C for 1 hour.
Inactivate at 70°C for 5 minutes.
Dispense 5 μl of Nuclease-Free Water/33 mM EDTA per well to achieve a final concentration of 25 mM.
Pool the content of multiple wells manually in a 1.5 mL or 5 mL eppendorf tube.
Spin down the tube and carefully remove the upper phase containing mineral oil.
Add 1.2 vol/vol ratio of AMPure XP beads pre-warmed at room temperature to the sample.
Mix thoroughly and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for at least 5 minutes until the liquid appears clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with freshly prepared 80% ethanol, ensuring it covers the beads completely.
Air-dry the beads at room temperature for no more than 5–8 minutes to prevent low DNA yield.
Remove the sample from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend the beads in 10 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Place the sample back on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for at least 5 min until the liquid appears clear.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 μl DNA LoBind tube.
Start with 8 μl from the previous step.
Add rATP+rUTP+rGTP+rCTP, 10x T7 polymerase buffer, T7 polymerase, and RNaseOUT™ Recombinant Ribonuclease Inhibitor to ice.
Incubate for 14 hours at 37 °C in a PCR thermocycler with the lid set at 70 °C.
Add 1 μl of DNase I (RNase-free) to the IVT product.
Incubate for 15 min at 37 °C.
Bring up the volume to 50 μl by adding 29 μl Nuclease-Free Water, then mix with 90 μl RNAClean XP beads pre-warmed at room temperature.
Mix thoroughly and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for at least 5 min until the liquid appears clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μl of freshly prepared 70% ethanol.
Air-dry the beads at room temperature.
Do not dry the beads for more than 5–8 min, since this may result in low DNA yield.
Remove the sample from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend the beads in 9.5 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Place the sample back on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for at least 5 min until the liquid appears clear.
Transfer 8.8 μl of supernatant to a new 0.5 μl DNA LoBind tube.
Check the library concentration with 1 μl using Qubit dsDNA BR kit.
Add 1 μl of 10 μM RA3 adapter to 7.8 μl obtained after RNA cleanup.
Incubate for 2 min @ 70 °C in a PCR thermocycler, then immediately place the sample on ice.
Add 3.2 μl of the following mix:
Mix RNA ligase buffer 1.2 μl, RNaseOUT Recombinant Ribonuclease Inhibitor 1 μl, T4 RNA ligase truncated 1 μl.
Incubate for 2 hours at 25 °C in a PCR thermocycler with the lid set at 30 °C.
Add 2 μl per sample of 10 μM RTP primer.
Incubate for 2 min at 70 °C in a PCR thermocycler.
Transfer the sample to ice quickly.
Add 5 μl of 5x SSIV buffer to each sample.
Add 1 μl of 25 mM dNTPs to each sample.
Add 2 μl of 0.1 M DTT to each sample.
Add 1 μl of RNaseOUT™ Recombinant Ribonuclease Inhibitor to each sample.
Add 2 μl of SuperScript IV reverse transcriptase to each sample.
Incubate for 20 min at 50 °C in a PCR thermocycler with the lid set at 80 °C.
Inactivate by incubating for 10 min at 80 °C in a PCR thermocycler with the lid set at 80 °C.
Add 16 μl per sample of the desired indexed Illumina primer.
Add 359 μl of nuclease-free water to each sample.
Add 200 μl of NEBNext® Ultra™ II PCR Master Mix to each sample.
Add 16 μl of 10 μM RP1 primer to each sample.
Divide the final mix into 8 PCR tubes, with each containing 50 μl.
Perform the following cycles in a PCR thermocycler:
98 °C for 30 sec.
Repeat cycle: 98 °C for 10 sec, then 60 °C for 30 sec, followed by 65 °C for 45 sec (repeat this set of steps 10 times).
Incubate at 65 °C for 5 min.
Hold at 4 °C.
Pool the 8 tubes for each sample and add 0.8 vol/vol ratio of AMPure XP beads pre-warmed at room temperature.
Mix thoroughly and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for at least 5 min until the liquid appears clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with 1 ml of freshly prepared 80% ethanol.
Air-dry the beads at room temperature.
Do not dry the beads for more than 5–8 min to avoid low DNA yield.
Remove the sample from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend the beads in 50 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Place the sample back on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for at least 5 min until the liquid appears clear.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 μl DNA LoBind tube.
Check the library concentration using Qubit dsDNA HS kit.
Check the fragment distribution on a Bioanalyzer 2100 using DNA HS chip.
Libraries can be stored for long time @ -20 °C.
